description: This source file defines a Java interface for reading deposit product data in a savings module of a financial application. It specifies methods for retrieving deposit product information based on account types and product IDs, with different retrieval options including lookup and chart slabs.

classes.name: DepositProductReadPlatformService
classes.description: An interface providing methods for retrieving deposit product data based on account type and product ID, including standard and detailed retrieval options.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Retrieves all deposit products for a given account type.

methods.name: retrieveAllForLookup
methods.description: Retrieves all deposit products for lookup purposes, filtered by account type.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific deposit product based on account type and product ID.

methods.name: retrieveOneWithChartSlabs
methods.description: Retrieves a specific deposit product along with its chart slabs, based on account type and product ID.
